mapper.sql: id, dict_type_id, dict_item_code, dict_item_name, dict_item_value, dict_item_label, status, sort_order, color_style, icon, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_dict_item WHERE dict_type_id = #{dictTypeId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT di. FROM sys_dict_item di JOIN sys_dict_type dt ON di.dict_type_id = dt.id WHERE dt.dict_type_code = #{dictTypeCode} AND di.deleted = 0 ORDER BY di.sort_order ASC, di.id ASC
SELECT di. FROM sys_dict_item di JOIN sys_dict_type dt ON di.dict_type_id = dt.id WHERE dt.dict_type_code = #{dictTypeCode} AND di.dict_item_value = #{dictItemValue} AND di.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
